actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +6, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +6, range 40/160 ft. _Hit:_ 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.text: _Charisma Saving Throw:_ DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). _Failure:_ The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The sprite casts _Invisibility_ on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. ## Spy
